prose: Plurai, founded by Nexar alumni, uses synthetic data and digital twins of a company's IT environment to train and test AI agents, adapting self-driving simulation techniques. The article cites benchmarks: LiveBench 2.0 has Claude Fable 5.2 at 82.9/100 and ChatGPT-6 Astra at 75.6, and an EON simulated-company test put Claude Opus 4.8 at 76.8% accuracy, so agents still need supervision.
highlights: Digital twins of corporate IT for agent training
Founders from Nexar, worked with Waymo
